description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a product-focused engineering team building a platform and marketplace for reinforcement learning environments. You will own end-to-end product work that helps environment creators and research teams create, evaluate, and improve AI agents.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with product, design, engineering, research, and go-to-market colleagues to identify user friction and prioritize improvements.

 - Speak with environment creators and research teams about their workflows for creating, testing, evaluating, and discovering environments.

 - Design, prototype, build, launch, and iterate on improvements across the platform and marketplace.

 - Develop frontend and backend features for onboarding, submissions, review, and discovery.

 - Make agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback easier to understand and act on.

 - Use user feedback and product data to evaluate outcomes and guide product tradeoffs.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience shipping software products end-to-end, from identifying user problems through implementation and iteration.

 - Full-stack web application experience, including polished frontend interfaces and backend services or APIs.

 - Technical education or equivalent technical background.

 - Experience interviewing users and applying qualitative feedback and product data to improve products.

 - Strong interaction design skills for complex technical workflows, along with sound product judgment and clear communication.

 - Background in developer tools, data-rich products, marketplaces, or products serving distinct user groups.

 - Familiarity with AI agents, evaluations, reinforcement learning, training data, or operational workflows such as review and debugging.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $100,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

Remote, with 70% to 80% time zone overlap with San Francisco or Singapore.
